analysis:
Examined all supplied test excerpts, patches and metadata against the canonical index and selected T-041 detail. No concrete security regression is established by these test-only changes. PlacementSetupCheck.swift:1260-1264 now explicitly supplies an empty publicModels list to retain records-only qualification assertions; surrounding owner-serving, artifact-binding, failed-shape and mode-family tests are unchanged, not new bypasses. Tests/ClusterPlacementChecks/run.sh:41 adds ClusterPublicModels.swift to the fixture executable; temporary build isolation, quoting and fixture compilation remain unchanged. ClusterOnboardingScopeSettingsTests.swift:11-20 asserts loopback local scope reaches wizard settings and that default/service settings defer scope to the saved record; it does not establish live listener or child-process behavior. ClusterRuntimeFactsCommandTests.swift:9-27 adds list/release-candidate parsing and rejection of contradictory modes, without exercising release verification.
Integration should examine ClusterPublicModels.swift with DistributedInstalledPairServingGrant.swift and runtime-facts/approval production changes: determine whether declarations affect display only or public admission, and preserve artifact identity, mode qualification and serving-authorization separation (T-007, T-027, T-052, T-054, T-056). Trace scope persistence through onboarding, re-planning and actual startup so local-only behavior cannot become public accidentally. ClusterRuntimeApprovalFactsTests.swift is metadata-only in the primary units; its orientation patch shows canonical-byte round-trip/release-version additions, but most changes and their production contracts are absent here. These are coverage limits, not findings. No supplied change modifies encryption, cache scoping (T-041), billing, attestation or privileged-helper controls. Tests were not run; runtime admission and release-facts conclusions remain for integration.
